sources.title: hiodoshi ao (1st costume)
sources.excerpt:
It consists of a [[blue shirt]], [[black vest]], [[black belt|belt]], and [[black pants|pants]], vertical stripe [[grey suit]], [[ear piercing]]s, and two [[necklace]]s. Her version of the ReGLOSS unit costume consists of a [[black choker]], [[white shirt|white]] [[collared shirt]], [[white jacket]] with the [[sleeves rolled up]], [[white shorts]], [[fishnet socks]], and [[white footwear|white]] high-cut [[sneakers]].
